text:
alia: Heads-up: PR #10211 updated the private installer quickstart but missed multi-homed gateway guidance and the PKCS#11 example. Can someone add short actionable snippets?
chris: I can add NAT examples. For sealed networks we prefer explicit SNAT to keep source stable for kube-probes. Sample: `iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.40.0.0/16 -j SNAT --to-source 198.51.100.17`
monica: Also call out sysctl for air-gapped hosts: ip_forward and rp_filter. Many operators forget to persist changes.
rafael: For HSM notes, prefer public ops link instead of internal runbook. Use: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/blob/main/kms/README.md#onprem-quickstart
monica: Draft sysctl snippet: ```
# enable IPv4 forwarding
echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward
# relax rp_filter for multi-homed interfaces
echo 0 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/all/rp_filter
# persist
cat >/etc/sysctl.d/99-redwood.conf <<EOF
net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=0
EOF
```
chris: Nice. Also update SDK snippet to show internal endpoint pattern (not api.redwood.ai). Proposed: ```
export REDWOOD_ENDPOINT=https://internal-redwood.<customer-vpc>.svc.cluster.local
python -c "import os, redwood; c = redwood.Client(endpoint=os.environ['REDWOOD_ENDPOINT'])"
```
rafael: PKCS#11 quick example to add under HSM section: ```
# list tokens (example using softhsm2)
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -L
# open token (login)
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -l --pin 1234
```
doc-bot: Link scanner: PR #10211 flagged internal URL: redwood-internal/kms-runbook -> replaced with public ops link.
alia: Thanks all. Action items: @chris add NAT + SDK snippet in PR, @monica add sysctl + persistence, @rafael drop PKCS#11 snippet and link. I'll run link check and merge if green.
chris: Pushed changes to branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10211/files
monica: Added persistence block and one-line TLS troubleshooting note (ensure cluster CA in trust store).
rafael: Confirmed PKCS#11 snippet included.
alia: Merged. Preview deploy asked. :shipit:
